scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix client && npm run start --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.logs:clear: rm -rf data/llm-logs data/llm-logs-summary && echo 'LLM logs cleared.'
